title: DORA Metrics - Leadtime and Deployment Frequency Usage
content:
This is a temporary (and internal) page. The idea is to gather this type of data in GitHub in the future. Below is to get an overview of current usage, as of this date.

Remarks

  • Ongoing/PR opened: IPEX Gallery

    • DevOps API consumer ID needs to be added for Gallery

  • On hold: Complete Sleep (PR created by Richard Persson)

  • DEXF has no implementation of lead-time for changes - they only use version “0.1C” (see below)

  • Översätta: Blocked

    • Other GitHub actions/workflow activities must be completed before

  • Space: Blocked

    • Space is currently performing a PoC, involving a new repository

      • Follow-up with team once this has been done.

Versions

As the DORA metrics solution has evolved, a couple of flavors have emerged:

  • An Azure Pipeline task called "devopsmetrics@0"

    • Referred to as version “0.1M” below

  • Plain curl requests for sending and updating deployment frequency

    • Referred to as version “0.1C” below

  • The first version of deployment frequency and change lead-time solution

    • Referred to as version “Legacy” below

  • The current deployment frequency and change lead-time solution

    • Referred to as version “V<MAJOR>” below

    • Release notes and current versions: https://github.com/inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-dora-metrics/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.md

    • Versioning strategy: https://github.com/actions/toolkit/blob/master/docs/action-versioning.md#versioning
